# Any scope. Universal entropy engine is enabled unless pre-game rule #9 is set to Lite.
oe_ent_rule_active = {
    NOT = { oe_rule_is_empire_entropy_lite = yes }
}

# Country scope. Byzantium / Restored Rome identification.
oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = {
    OR = {
        tag = BYZ
        tag = ROM
    }
}

# Country scope. Eligible giant empire for transparent five-dimensional entropy tracking:
#   - BYZ/ROM at >= 150 locations or once oe_ar_strain is active (merges seamlessly, zero double penalty)
#   - Restored Great Yuan (CHI) at >= 150 locations
#   - Tsardom of Russia (RUS) at >= 150 locations
#   - Any sovereign non-rebel giant empire at >= 200 locations
#   - Or explicitly forced on via test button (var:oe_ent_force_on)
oe_ent_eligible_empire = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    is_subject = no
    oe_ent_rule_active = yes
    OR = {
        has_variable = oe_ent_force_on
        AND = {
            NOT = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = yes
                    OR = {
                        num_locations >= 150
                        has_variable = oe_ar_strain
                    }
                }
                AND = {
                    OR = {
                        tag = CHI
                        tag = RUS
                    }
                    num_locations >= 150
                }
                num_locations >= 200
            }
        }
    }
}
